scripts.dev: concurrently "npm start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && VITE_API_BASE_URL='' npm run build --prefix client && rm -rf server/public && mv client/dist server/public
